stops.note: from 'ḥamma', to heat; the Islamic world kept up the Roman public bath
the architect Sinan built great domed baths in Istanbul, such as the Haseki Hürrem hamam of 1556
the diplomat David Urquhart promoted 'Turkish baths' in Britain; the first opened near Blarney in Ireland in 1856

current_meaning: a Turkish or Middle Eastern steam bath
